name: Incarnation Camp
description_short: Nonprofit overnight camp for ages 7-15 on a 740-acre wooded property with a private, spring-fed lake in Ivoryton, CT. Campers live in platform tents and come for 2, 4 or 6 weeks. Campers 14-15 join Pioneer Village, the teen program, with cooking over a fire and 5-day hike, bike or canoe trips.
activities: Pioneer Village 5-day hike, bike and canoe trips (ages 14-15)

refund_policy_summary: No refund if a camper is sent home for behavior or withdrawn early. If a camper is too ill or contagious to stay, a pro-rated fee is negotiated, and a doctor's note may be required.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming and boating on the camp's own 1.3-mile spring-fed lake, with no motorboats. Waterfront staff and counselors are American Red Cross lifeguard trained; swim classes for all abilities.
